none: PAS NLM-5D3D53: Early Mwedeval Spindle Whorl from Wickenby
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

lead. Spindle Whorl, as identified by finder. Cast plano-convex whorl with a central perforation tapering from diameter 12.3mm to 8.6mm. Faint scratches visible beneath patination appear to be casually executed decoration; this includes a grid of horizontal and vertical lines and other vertical, horizontal and occasionally diagonal lines; these do not, however, form discernible characters, though…
